market_view.description: One plain sentence on today's market for the father.

market_view_bn.description: The same sentence in plain Bengali.

probability.description: Chance this stock beats the Nifty 50 by more than its hurdle over about three months.

points.description: Percentage points this reason moved the probability from the base rate; negative lowers it.

summary.description: One short plain-English sentence the father can act on.

summary_bn.description: The same sentence in plain Bengali.

level_flag.description: One sentence on why the code's entry, stop or target looks wrong for this stock; null when they look fine. You never set the levels.

change_reason.description: One plain sentence on what changed since the previous call; null when nothing did or there is no previous call.

would_buy_if.description: One line: what would make you buy this stock; null when you would buy it tonight.

news_used.description: ids of dossier news items that mattered

for.description: Optional. Up to 3 plain reasons this stock may beat the Nifty, each resting on the brief. Every number in `text` must be in the brief or the item is dropped.

news_used.description: ids of the dossier news items it rests on

points.description: Optional. Percentage points this reason moved the probability; always positive here.

against.description: Optional. Up to 3 plain reasons it may not, same shape as `for`; `points` is the size of the push down, written positive.

what_we_do_not_know.description: Optional. Owner-only: what you could not tell from the brief. Never shown to the father.

broken_reason.description: Holdings only. One plain sentence on why the reason for owning this stock has broken for good; null when it has not. A low chance, a weak quarter or a falling price is not a broken reason.
